blocks.content: Various factors can be considered while analyzing an algorithm. Among them, two factors are particularly important:

items: Time Complexity:  How long an algorithm takes to run with respect to the input size.
Space Complexity: How much space an algorithm takes to run with respect to the input size.

blocks.content: In the next chapter, we will dive deeper into time complexity.
